main_text.p: Zephiri in hunc locum, & penficulatè obferuet, fi Christianis hoc sæculo ad Imperatori resistendum vires defuerint. Cur non igitur ad arma confugiunt? cur non audent aliquid?

Num quia mitiùs hoc tempore cum illis actum, quàm sæculis retroactis? nihil minus. Audi rursùs ipsum Tertullianum, de huius sæculi sæuitia ità conquerentem [{f}quoties in Christianos de-Ibidem.„ sæuitis? partim animis propriis, partim Legibus obsequentes? quoties „ etiam perterritis vobis suo iure nos „ inimicum vulgus invadit? lapidibus „ &incendiis; imò ipsis Bacchanalium „ furiis? nec mortuis parcunt Christianis; quin illos de requie sepulturæ, de „ asylo quodam mortis iam alios, iam „ nec totos avellant, dissecent, distrahant.] Et alibi in eodem Apologetico, [crucibus & stipitibus imponitis „ Christianos, unguis deraditis latera „ Christianorum, & ceruices, ponitis „ ante plumbum, & glutinum & gomphos, ad bestias impellimur, ignibus „ urimur „

page.notes: The right margin note "Ibidem." is printed in italic beside the line with the mark f, which is also the mark of the superscript f before "quoties". The paragraph runs from the previous page; the verse lines are set off in italic. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed "j" used as vowel i has been corrected to i. The quotation marks „ at line ends are printed as they stand. Possible printing error: "fuo iure" read as suo (long s). Nothing illegible on the page.
